rule.description: Only match Users that reside in the configured container/subtree
rule.comment: This rule marks events in the given containers for processing by adding the unmached-src-dn and attempt-to-match operation properties. You can add subtrees in the ILM Vault for inclusion by adding if-src-dn conditionals here. The attempt-to-match property determines whether the matching policies following this initializing policy should try to match the object or whether its out of scope.
